forecastPolicy: Do not invent numeric revenue when observed sales, PV, conversion, acquisition or install data are absent. Use ranked opportunity bands until measurable signals exist.

rankedOpportunities.basis: The app has a verified public PWA and prepared listing, but Store identity/submission is incomplete. Completing the live Store funnel unlocks page-view, acquisition, install, campaign and product-page experiment data, which has the highest information value for later scaling.

note official analysis of approximately 300,000 paid articles reports 1,842 JPY average price among top-20%-selling practical know-how articles. Existing account products are mostly below this, but repricing current products is deferred until PV/sales evidence exists.
Complementary public source assets make incremental build cost low and can increase order value, but no demand signal exists yet; prepare only, do not treat as proven.
A coherent buyer journey exists and the free interview STAR tool already points to the verified consistency product, but sales evidence is absent.
Microsoft supports custom campaign IDs and conversion reporting. Add source-specific links only after the live CSV Cleaner Store URL exists.
